resolution_notes: base_url: Auditor correct. Official LinkedIn versioned APIs use https://api.linkedin.com/rest with LinkedIn-Version header (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/versioning; https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/shared/api-guide/concepts/protocol-version). /v2 remains for some legacy paths including OIDC userinfo (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/consumer/integrations/self-serve/sign-in-with-linkedin-v2). example.response_snippet: Auditor correct. LinkedIn OIDC UserInfo uses BCP 47 locale en-US, not en_US (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/consumer/integrations/self-serve/sign-in-with-linkedin-v2#api-request-to-retreive-member-details).
